definition: First day of the calendar month used as the monthly timestamp
transformation: Parsed from DSEC periodString and normalised to YYYY-MM-01
notes: All monthly joins use this field

definition: Calendar year of the observation
transformation: month.dt.year
notes: Used for annual aggregation and faceting

definition: Calendar month number from 1 to 12
transformation: month.dt.month
notes: Used for seasonal profiles and month matching

definition: Monthly visitor arrivals
transformation: Cast to integer and checked for positivity
notes: No values imputed or interpolated

definition: Analytical phase label
transformation: 2008-2019 Growth and Baseline; 2020-2022 Disruption; 2023-Jul 2026 Recovery
notes: Descriptive grouping only

definition: Year-over-year growth in visitor arrivals
transformation: (current month / same month previous year - 1) x 100
notes: NaN for the first 12 months by construction

definition: Monthly arrivals relative to the same calendar month in 2019
transformation: current month / matching 2019 month x 100
notes: Not a measure of spending or economic welfare

definition: Guests of hotel establishments
transformation: Cast to integer and aligned to the same monthly grid
notes: Not equivalent to unique visitors or all overnight visitors

definition: Annual international visitor arrivals
transformation: Extracted from the World Bank JSON API response
notes: Observed 1995-2020 only

definition: GDP per capita in current US dollars
unit: current US$ per person per year
transformation: Extracted from the World Bank JSON API response
notes: Observed 1995-2025

definition: Annual sum of DSEC monthly visitor arrivals
transformation: Sum of monthly visitor_arrivals by year
notes: 2026 is a partial-year sum

definition: Flag indicating a DSEC annual total from an incomplete year
transformation: True for 2026 and False otherwise
notes: Used to prevent treating 2026 as a complete year

definition: Flag indicating both World Bank arrivals and GDP per capita are present
transformation: visitor_arrivals_wb.notna() AND gdp_pc_usd.notna()
notes: The regression uses only rows where this is True

definition: Source-market category used in the composition analysis
transformation: Top eight 2025 markets plus Other residual
notes: Other is a group and not a single market

definition: Visitor arrivals from the market in 2024
transformation: Extracted from the official release
notes: Top-eight selection is based on 2025

definition: Visitor arrivals from the market in 2025
transformation: Extracted from the official release
notes: Latest complete year in the project

definition: Market share of total 2024 visitor arrivals
transformation: arrivals_2024 / total 2024 arrivals x 100
notes: Shares include the Other residual

definition: Market share of total 2025 visitor arrivals
transformation: arrivals_2025 / total 2025 arrivals x 100
notes: Shares include the Other residual

definition: Year-over-year change in arrivals by source market
transformation: (arrivals_2025 / arrivals_2024 - 1) x 100
notes: Descriptive growth rate

definition: Flag indicating a named top-eight source market
transformation: True for the top eight and False for Other residual
notes: Used to distinguish named markets from the residual

definition: Entry transport mode
transformation: Assigned from the official checkpoint grouping
notes: Land Sea or Air

definition: Named entry checkpoint
transformation: Extracted from the official checkpoint table
notes: Visitor arrivals rather than all-person crossings

definition: Visitor arrivals by checkpoint in 2025
transformation: Extracted and checked against the published total of 40069360
notes: Only source with true visitor arrivals by individual checkpoint

definition: Checkpoint share of total 2025 visitor arrivals
transformation: visitor_arrivals_2025 / total 2025 visitor arrivals x 100
notes: Shares sum to 100 subject to rounding

definition: English district name
transformation: Read from the raw Excel workbook
notes: Display label

definition: Portuguese district name
transformation: Read from the raw Excel workbook
notes: Used for matching to statistics-zone GeoJSON

definition: Recorded visitor person-times by district
transformation: Summed over Overall origin and months 1-7 of 2026
notes: One person can contribute multiple person-times

definition: District share of recorded visitor person-times
transformation: district person-times / total person-times x 100
notes: Not a unique-visitor share
